sentences.text:
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:177449
Court No. - 66
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 39035 of 2024

Applicant :- Ali Hasan
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Anil Kumar Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Heard Sri Anil Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Imran Khan, learned Aga
for the State-respondent.
2.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
59 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Saraiylakhansi, District Mau, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

3. FIR of the present case was lodged against the applicant and his family members on 18.2.2024 and according to the FIR, marriage of the applicant was solemnized with the daughter of the informant about three and half years before and after marriage, applicant and his family members tortured her for demand of Rs. One lakh and on their consistent demand, informant, however, paid Rs. Forty thousand but in spite of that they continued the torture of his daughter and on 3.7.2023,
informant received an information that applicant and his family members by administering some poisonous substance tried to commit the murder of his daughter and when he arrived at her matrimonial home then found that his daughter was lying dead in the Sadar hospital.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is husband of the deceased and on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and torture, he has been made accused in the present matter.

5. He further submitted that actually marriage of the applicant with the deceased was his second marriage and with his first wife applicant is having four children and deceased did not ready to look after the children who were born delivered from the first wife of the applicant and only due to this reason some dispute arose between husband and wife i.e. deceased and thereafter, she committed suicide by consuming some poisonous substance.

6. He further submitted that even viscera report of the deceased also suggests that she died due to consumption of alminium phosphide, therefore, at this stage, it cannot be said that it is not a case of suicidal death.

7. He further submitted that deceased died on 3.7.2023 but FIR of the present case was lodged on 18.2.2024 i.e. after more than seven months of the alleged incident and this fact clearly suggests that on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and torture, FIR of the present case was lodged.
8.
He further submitted that applicant is having no criminal history and he is in jail in the present matter since 25.9.2024.

9. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that applicant is husband of the deceased but could not dispute the fact that FIR of the present case was lodged after more than seven months and deceased died due to consumption of alminium phosphide.
10. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

11. However, it reflects that applicant is husband of the deceased and his wife died within four years of her marriage under abnormal circumstances in her matrimonial home and there is also allegation of demand of dowry but considering the fact that deceased died due to consumption of aluminum phosphide and this is the second marriage of the applicant with the deceased, the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the applicant with regard to the alleged suicide committed by the deceased, cannot be ruled out, at this stage.
12.

Further, the alleged incident is said to have been taken place on 3.7.2023 but FIR of the present case was lodged on 18.2.2024 i.e. after more than seven months of the alleged incident and no cogent reason has been assigned for such inordinate delay of more than seven months in lodging the FIR of the present case.
13. Further applicant is having no criminal history and he is in jail in the present matter since 25.9.2024.

14. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case, discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.

Ali Hasan vs State Of U.P. on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/15508534/
2 15.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

16. Let the applicant-Ali Hasan, be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
17. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

18. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
Order Date :- 12.11.2024 Ankita  Ali Hasan vs State Of U.P. on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/15508534/
